sloka: न हि युद्धेन मे कार्यं नैव प्राणैर्न सीतया ।भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं रणपांसुषु ।। ६.१०२.११ ।।
transliteration: na hi yuddhena me kāryaṁ naiva prāṇairna sītayā ।bhrātaraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṁ raṇapāṁsuṣu ।। 6.102.11 ।।

translations.english: Beholding his dear brother, who is his life outside him overcome by anxiety, Rama lost senses and gave himself to great sorrow.
